headline: Seafood Line Cook
summary: Former fish port worker now cooking on the seafood line of a restaurant in Zamboanga del Sur. Five years handling and sorting fresh catch taught me how to judge and keep seafood fresh; I trained in cookery and now prepare and cook fish and shellfish dishes while following food safety and hygiene rules.
skills: Food preparation: filleting, cleaning and portioning

experience.title: Seafood Line Cook
bullets: Clean, fillet and portion fish and shellfish for the day's service.
Cook grilled, soup and kinilaw dishes on the seafood line.
Follow the kitchen's hygiene rules for raw seafood and keep chillers at the right temperature.

experience.title: Fish Port Worker
bullets: Unloaded, sorted and iced fresh catch at the landing site before dawn.
Dried and smoked fish for the cooperative's processing unit.
Kept tools, crates and the sorting area clean following hygiene rules.
